core.title: China Urban Heat Island Observation Dataset 2018-2025
creators: National Earth System Science Data Center
core.publisher: National Earth System Science Data Center
core.description: A multi-source urban heat island observation dataset covering 35 major Chinese cities from 2018 to 2025. The dataset integrates ground meteorological stations, Landsat surface temperature products, land-use maps, and urban morphology indicators for climate adaptation and urban planning research.
funders: National Key Research and Development Program of China, 2023YFC3009000
National Natural Science Foundation of China, 42375092

dataset_basic_information.Title: China Urban Heat Island Observation Dataset 2018-2025
dataset_basic_information.Abstract: This dataset provides harmonized hourly air temperature observations, satellite-derived land surface temperature, impervious-surface fraction, vegetation index, building density, and quality-control flags for 35 Chinese cities.

Scope.Spatial Range: 35 major cities in China, including Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Shenzhen, Chengdu, Wuhan, Xi'an, and Harbin

dataset_basic_information.File Content: Hourly station tables, monthly gridded GeoTIFF files, city boundary shapefiles, station metadata, quality-control reports, and a variable dictionary.
dataset_basic_information.Funding Project: National Key Research and Development Program of China, 2023YFC3009000

Affiliation: National Earth System Science Data Center
Institute of Atmospheric Physics, Chinese Academy of Sciences
Dataset Authors.Contribution: Dataset design, station data harmonization, remote sensing processing, quality assessment, and documentation.
Dataset Authors.Biography: The authors work on urban climate observation, remote sensing data fusion, and climate-service data infrastructure.

dataset_publication_information.Version Information: v2.1, includes 2025 station observations and updated Landsat Collection 2 products

dataset_service_information.Dataset Citation: National Earth System Science Data Center; Liu X.; Chen R.; Wang M. China Urban Heat Island Observation Dataset 2018-2025. Scientific Data Bank, 2026.
dataset_service_information.Dataset Usage Statement: Users should cite the dataset and related data paper. Redistribution of derived city-level products should retain quality-control flags.

extension_info: The test file intentionally mixes tabular, raster, vector, and documentation metadata to exercise nested domain-field mapping.
